title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: When I was growing up, I always wanted to be an astronaut. That didn't happen, but I read this book. What would I have done if I was stuck on the red rock? Would I have the stubbornness to survive? This level of tenacity? The ability to improvise? A great read if I ever want to give up. If Mark Watney can survive Mars, maybe I can survive that obstacle in front of me.
reasons: want hard sci-fi that is actually funny
like watching a smart person solve one problem after another
enjoy engineering detail and realistic space travel
want an optimistic book about people cooperating
